en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, both together, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The divorced woman, when she sees the blood from her third menstruation, so she is irrevocably divorced from him’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr all from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When a divorced woman experiences blood discharge of the third Hayd (menses) she becomes stranger to him.’”
